symbols.name: evaluation point
symbols.meaning: The real point at which both functions are evaluated, taken to infinity.
symbols.quote: Here $\lambda$ is the real point at which both functions are evaluated, and it is taken to infinity.

symbols.name: bounded function
symbols.meaning: The function being bounded, mapping the positive reals to the positive reals.
symbols.quote: The function $\varphi$ is the one being bounded, and $\psi$ is the comparison function, positive for all large $\lambda$; both map the positive reals to the positive reals.

symbols.name: comparison function
symbols.meaning: The comparison function, positive for all large lambda, mapping the positive reals to the positive reals.
symbols.quote: The function $\varphi$ is the one being bounded, and $\psi$ is the comparison function, positive for all large $\lambda$; both map the positive reals to the positive reals.

symbols.name: big-O constant
symbols.meaning: A constant such that the running time is at most C times n(lg n) to the power 1 minus kappa for all sufficiently large n.
symbols.quote: Let $C$ be a constant with $T_A(n) \le C\,n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.

symbols.name: lower-bound constant
symbols.meaning: A positive constant, depending on the machine A, in the optimality conjecture's lower bound on T_A(n).
symbols.quote: The [optimality conjecture](n-log-n-conjecture.md) asserts that each exact multiplication machine $A$ has a positive constant $c_A$, depending on $A$, with $T_A(n) \ge c_A\,n\lg n$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
